title: Add mid-session skill management for Copilot provider. Wire up rpc.skills.enable(), rpc.skills.disable(), and rpc.skills.reload() SDK methods. Add UI toggles to enable/disable individual skills during an active session without restarting.
notes: False upstream_merged verdict. Recipe only had error-handling scaffolding around skill discovery, not the actual enable/disable/reload RPC + UI toggles. The scaffolding is present because it was part of the CopilotAdapter brought with copilot-cli-provider. Feature core (toggle UI) was never implemented.
